summary: Frontend tests of the expanded Party section (100 games) on the public URL, mostly at a 430x900 mobile viewport. All 19 requested games passed. Every page loaded its cover, level 1 opened, the intro and countdown ran, the <defid>-board rendered, taps made moves, the <defid>-status line updated, there were no page errors, and nothing overflowed horizontally (scrollWidth difference 0 on every game). Duels: ultimate, dominoes, ataxx, oware, order, cornerrace, knighttrap, turtles, dodgem. Each shows party-player-0 and party-player-1, the party-turn-clock ('Your move · 20s', counting down) and the party-match-clock. The bot replied within 2.6 s on every measured move. When the turn clock runs out, a move is made automatically (Knight Trap, after waiting 24 s). Dominoes was won to a 3-star pass, and Turning Turtles was lost to practice-fail. Solos: merge2048, mines, wordfive, yacht, make24, pyramid, zip, echo, pipes, sudoku6. Player 1 is 'Host Zara · cheering', with no rival bot, a level clock, and no turn clock. Yacht was played on purpose (roll, hold, roll, score Chance = 17, turn 2/7), and a Zip Path step went 1/25 to 2/25. Ludo Royale played for about 70 s at mobile size: 23 rolls and 21 token picks with bot turns in between, it never froze (longest status stall about 6 s), and there were no errors. Chat works: party-chat-send posts the bubble and clears the input, reactions and quick replies post, and the bot answers. The party-theme-name header shows 'Level 1 · Neon City'. Levels 1-5 vs 6-10 was checked in code only (themeFor uses floor((lv-1)/5): Neon City, then Jungle Temple). Levels 6+ are locked for both the player and the admin account, so this could not be checked in the UI. Catalog: /games with the Party chip shows 100 unique /games/pty_* cards, all 100 covers load, none are broken, and the 100 cover URLs in gameCovers.js are unique. Rooms: /play/ABC123 signed out shows the 'Sign in to join' room-signin-btn linking to /login?next=/play/ABC123. Signed in as player1, Reversi 'Play with friends' created room 47FBDE (lobby, invite link, Copy/Share/WhatsApp). MAJOR GAP: none of the 36 new duels can be played with friends.

minor.issue: Returns 422 for most AI banter on game events. BanterInput.event max_length=40 is too short for the strings the client builds: duel.jsx:46 'you beat the human at ${title}', duel.jsx:68 'the human just made a huge move against you in ${title}', solo.jsx:19 'the player solved the ${title}…'. SweetSwap/BlockBlast game strings are also over game max_length=60. Confirmed with curl ('you beat the human at Ultimate Tic Tac Toe' gives 422 string_too_long). The client silently falls back to canned lines, so AI banter on win/lose/big moves never runs. Backend log shows about 45 of 91 banter calls returned 422.

ui_bugs.issue: None of the 36 new turn-based duels (pty_ultimate_ttt, pty_dominoes, pty_ataxx, pty_oware, pty_order_chaos, pty_corner_race, pty_knight_trap, pty_turtles, pty_dodgem, pty_teeko, pty_achi, pty_konane, pty_hexapawn, …) are in ONLINE_GAMES (frontend/src/lib/partyRoom.js has 24 ids, and backend party_rooms_routes.py ONLINE_GAMES has the same 24). So no practice-play-friends button appears, even signed in, and POST /api/party/rooms would reject them. PARTY_ONLINE in index.jsx already maps every DUELS entry. This breaks the requirement that turn-based games can be played vs friends.

integration_issues.issue: Win/lose/big-move AI lines get 422 from /api/games/practice/banter (event too long). Only canned lines show.

issues: The knight glyphs (sky-300 and rose-400 ♞) look small and low-contrast, especially the blue knight on bg-slate-400 squares. Crumbled squares are only a subtle orange inset next to the dark checker squares.
The pyramid rows overlap heavily. The suits/ranks of the second-to-bottom row are partly hidden behind the bottom row.
Grammar: '1 rolls left' should be '1 roll left'.
Only the last 2 messages are visible, so the player's own typed or quick-reply message is pushed out within about 1-3 s when the bot replies.
Any 5 letters are accepted as a guess (no dictionary check). That may be intended, but it makes the game trivial to brute-force.

action_items: HIGH: Add all 36 new duel ids (and any other DUELS ids missing) to ONLINE_GAMES in frontend/src/lib/partyRoom.js AND backend/routers/party_rooms_routes.py (max players 2), so 'Play with friends' / room create works for e.g. pty_ultimate_ttt. Better: derive the frontend list from PARTY_ONLINE keys so it cannot drift.
Raise BanterInput.event max_length (e.g. 160) and game max_length (e.g. 120) in backend/routers/practice_routes.py, or shorten the client event strings, so AI banter stops getting 422.
Make the Knight Trap knights bigger and higher-contrast, and make crumbled squares stand out more.
Reduce the vertical overlap in the Pyramid 13 layout at 430px.
Fix the '1 rolls left' plural in the Yacht status.
critical_code_review_comments: ONLINE_GAMES is copied by hand in 2 places (lib/partyRoom.js and party_rooms_routes.py) and has fallen out of sync with PARTY_ONLINE (which already includes every duel). Use one source of truth.
useBanter catches every error silently. A 422 here should at least be logged in dev, because the validation mismatch went unnoticed.
Dominoes has no boneyard or draw, so with 14 of 28 tiles in play the game often blocks after 2-3 moves and is decided by pips. That may be intended, but games end abruptly.
Several party files are very dense one-line JSX (duels4-6, solos3-5), which makes review and maintenance hard.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all 19 sampled games, Ludo, chat, clocks, catalog and room sign-in guard pass; friend rooms missing for the 36 new duels)

seed_data_creation: As player1@example.com, created a party room 47FBDE for pty_reversi (lobby only, not started). Chat message 'TEST_hello bot' was sent locally in a practice game (not persisted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each party page /games/pty_*: Decline cookies, click practice-level-1, then practice-start, then wait about 4.2 s for the countdown. Board is [data-testid$='-board'] and status is [data-testid$='-status']. On duels, wait for party-turn-clock, which shows only on your turn. Random taps work for one-tap games; two-step games (corner race, dodgem, ataxx) need select-then-target. The sweep loop is in /app/tests/party_sweep_snippet.py. Ludo: click ludo-roll when enabled and enabled ludo-token-* via JS. Login: login-email, login-password, email-submit (redirects to /choose-world). Levels above 1 are locked for both player1 and admin, so the level 6 world (Jungle Temple) is still unverified in the UI. Retest: practice-play-friends on pty_ultimate_ttt after the ONLINE_GAMES fix, plus banter 200s.
